title: Overdraft limit increase in the mobile app
requirement: Customers who already have an overdraft at Demo Bank should be able to request a higher limit from the mobile app. The new limit can be up to 3 times the monthly salary. The system checks the request and, if approved, the new limit is active immediately. If the request is not approved, the customer keeps the current limit.

expectations.description: Asks which salary figure is used (net, average, last month)
Asks how often a customer can request an increase
Asks about customers whose overdraft is currently overdrawn or in arrears
Asks about customers whose salary is not paid into Demo Bank
States the 3x salary rule as a business rule
Raises contract amendment / customer acceptance of new terms
Has a boundary UAT case at exactly 3x salary
Has a UAT case above 3x salary
Has a UAT case confirming the current limit is kept after rejection
